objective: Refine an agent-safe Hostinger VPS deployment plan using existing Docker and Traefik without exposing secrets to deploying agents.

selected_overlays.reason: The target needs a clear non-executed plan and handoff without runtime deployment.
Production secrets, Strava credentials, SSH, and friend activity evidence are sensitive and must stay outside agent-visible artifacts.
The VPS owns secrets and Traefik runtime state; repository artifacts own only deploy interfaces and placeholder contracts.

subagent_strategy.reason: The plan is narrow and local evidence plus operator update are enough for this proposal.

gates: No real secrets enter repository artifacts.
Agent deploy path cannot require env value visibility.
Traefik replaces Caddy for the Hostinger VPS path.
Deploy receipt is redacted before tracking.

next_route.summary: Implement agent-safe Traefik deploy harness and docs.
